references.text: Rahab had hidden the spies under the stalks of flax on the roof, which explains why she now goes up to the roof to speak with them
Lot also received foreign guests and protected them, in a similar way that Rahab received the Israelite spies
The Mosaic law commanded railings on roofs, showing that roofs in Israel were used as living spaces, just as Rahab used hers
Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof, demonstrating that roofs were common places for private conversations in Israel
David went up to the roof of his palace, illustrating the use of roofs as living spaces in Old Testament times
Peter went up to the roof to pray, showing the continued use of roofs as places for retreat and important events
